instruction: Install the Prettier code formatter extension in VS Code.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully installed autoDocstring extension by opening Extensions panel (Ctrl+Shift+X), searching 'autoDocstring', and clicking Install. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VS Code UI, use keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+X), search extensions marketplace, locate and click Install buttons
metadata.task_rationale: Same extension installation pattern with a different popular extension (Prettier). Tests same capability with a different target.
metadata.explanation: Task requires installing Prettier extension. Evaluator uses code --list-extensions to verify esbenp.prettier-vscode is installed.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic logic is correct: instruction requires installing Prettier extension, evaluator checks if esbenp.prettier-vscode appears in installed extensions list via code --list-extensions.
Extension ID esbenp.prettier-vscode is the correct identifier for the Prettier code formatter extension.
Metric is_extension_installed correctly receives the rules dict directly and performs a containment check, which is appropriate for verifying extension installation.
Coverage is complete: single instruction requirement (install extension) is fully covered by the single evaluator check.

Minor issue: The command array includes pipe and grep tokens ['|', 'grep', 'esbenp.prettier-vscode'] which will be passed as literal arguments to 'code' since shell=False (default). The pipe will NOT be interpreted as a shell pipe. The 'code' CLI may ignore these extra arguments and still return the full extension list (in which case the metric's containment check would still work), or it may error. The grep/pipe is redundant since the metric already performs the containment check.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Remove the pipe and grep from the command array. Change command to ['code', '--list-extensions'] since the metric already checks for containment of 'esbenp.prettier-vscode'. The current command with shell=False will not pipe correctly.
Alternatively, if piping is desired, set 'shell': true in the result config and pass the command as a single string: 'code --list-extensions | grep esbenp.prettier-vscode'.
